title: WHO Bangladesh health-priority indicators
notes: These indicators describe population-level context and are not diagnostic signals.
All Bangladesh rows from the selected indicator datasets are retained as provided; values and interval bounds are not recalculated. source_row identifies the row in the supplied dataset CSV.
The package dataset rows may extend beyond their metadata temporal-coverage statements; both are recorded as supplied.
Top causes of death / leading causes estimates were not present in the supplied package and are not reconstructed.
The wasting dataset contains multiple observations for some year/sex combinations; all rows are preserved because the supplied dimensions do not justify choosing one.
